# With CGO_ENABLED=bindings, the module index makes the same decisions
# about which packages are cgo binding packages as loading packages
# without it.

env GOEXPERIMENT=$GOEXPERIMENT,runtimecgopurego,cgobindings
[!GOEXPERIMENT:cgobindings] skip

env CGO_ENABLED=bindings
[!GOOS:windows] [!cgolinkext] env CC=/bin/false
[GOOS:windows] env CC=nonexistent-cc
env GOFLAGS=-modcacherw

go get example.com/cgobindings@v1.0.0

# Binding packages from the module cache, which is indexed, build without
# a C compiler. withc has no binding pragmas, so it is built as with
# CGO_ENABLED=0, using its fallback.
go run .
stdout '^withc=1 fallback=4$'

# A package with binding pragmas that also contains C files is an error.
! go build example.com/cgobindings/withcfiles
stderr 'source files requiring a C compiler not allowed in a package using cgo binding pragmas: cfile.c'

# The module index and direct loading agree, for the module's packages
# and for the standard library.
go list -e -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.CgoFiles}} {{.GoFiles}} {{.IgnoredGoFiles}} {{.CFiles}}' example.com/cgobindings/...
cp stdout index.txt
stdout '^example.com/cgobindings/withcfiles \[bind.go\] \[\] \[\] \[cfile.c\]$'
stdout '^example.com/cgobindings/fallback \[bind.go\] \[\] \[nocgo.go\] \[\]$'
stdout '^example.com/cgobindings/withc \[\] \[fallback.go\] \[withc.go\] \[\]$'
go list -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.CgoFiles}} {{.GoFiles}} {{.IgnoredGoFiles}}' std
cp stdout std-index.txt
stdout '^runtime/cgo \[\] \[.+\]'

env GODEBUG=goindex=0
! go build example.com/cgobindings/withcfiles
stderr 'source files requiring a C compiler not allowed in a package using cgo binding pragmas: cfile.c'
go list -e -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.CgoFiles}} {{.GoFiles}} {{.IgnoredGoFiles}} {{.CFiles}}' example.com/cgobindings/...
cmp stdout index.txt
go list -f '{{.ImportPath}} {{.CgoFiles}} {{.GoFiles}} {{.IgnoredGoFiles}}' std
cmp stdout std-index.txt

-- go.mod --
module m

go 1.28
-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/cgobindings/fallback"
	"example.com/cgobindings/withc"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Printf("withc=%d fallback=%d\n", withc.One(), fallback.Abs(-4))
}
